items.title: Service & Maintenance
items.short: Planned preventative maintenance to keep systems running efficiently.
items.text: Planned preventative maintenance programmes to keep your systems running efficiently, reduce breakdowns, and extend equipment life. We service all major manufacturers.

items.title: Reactive Repairs
items.short: Fast-response callout for breakdowns and emergencies.
items.text: Fast-response callout service for breakdowns and emergencies. Our engineers carry a wide range of parts to resolve issues on the first visit wherever possible.

items.title: Installation
items.short: Full design and install from single splits to multi-zone VRV.
items.text: Full design and installation of air conditioning and ventilation systems for residential, commercial, and industrial applications. From single splits to multi-zone VRV systems.

items.title: TM44 Air Conditioning Inspections
items.short: Statutory energy inspections for systems over 12kW.
items.text: Mandatory energy assessments for air conditioning systems over 12kW, as required by UK building regulations. We provide full compliance reports.

items.title: F-Gas Leak Checks
items.short: Certified, logged leak checks to F-Gas regulations.
items.text: Regulatory leak checks for systems containing fluorinated greenhouse gases, fully compliant with F-Gas regulations. Certified and logged.

items.title: Testing & Validation Reports
items.text: Comprehensive commissioning, testing, and validation documentation for new and existing HVAC installations to ensure regulatory compliance.

items.title: SHTM 03-01 AHU Inspections
items.short: Healthcare air handling unit inspections and compliance.
items.text: Specialist air handling unit inspections for healthcare facilities in line with Scottish Health Technical Memorandum 03-01 guidelines, including AHU O&M documentation.

items.title: Indoor Air Quality Testing & Solutions
items.text: Assessment and improvement of indoor air quality through monitoring, filtration upgrades, and ventilation optimisation for healthier environments.

items.title: BESS Battery Storage Air Conditioning
items.short: Specialised cooling for battery energy storage systems.
items.text: Specialised cooling solutions for Battery Energy Storage Systems, ensuring optimal operating temperatures and protecting critical infrastructure.

items.title: 4D Remote Monitoring
items.short: Live sensor data and fault alerts for your plant.
items.text: Smart building sensors that give live and historical data on plant performance, temperatures, humidity and CO₂ – with no BMS integration required.
